performance_optimizations.title: Implement React Component Memoization
performance_optimizations.description: Add React.memo and useMemo/useCallback hooks to prevent unnecessary re-renders in the frontend components, especially for components that receive complex objects as props or perform expensive computations.

performance_optimizations.title: Add Code Splitting and Lazy Loading
performance_optimizations.description: Implement React.lazy and Suspense for route-based code splitting in the Vite/React frontend to reduce initial bundle size and improve first contentful paint.

performance_optimizations.title: Optimize Zustand Store Subscriptions
performance_optimizations.description: Review Zustand store selectors to ensure components only subscribe to the specific state slices they need, preventing unnecessary re-renders when unrelated state changes.

performance_optimizations.title: Add API Response Caching
performance_optimizations.description: Implement caching strategies for backend API responses to reduce redundant computations and improve response times for frequently accessed endpoints.

performance_optimizations.title: Optimize Electron IPC Communication
performance_optimizations.description: Review and optimize Electron IPC calls between main and renderer processes, batch multiple small requests where possible, and consider using shared memory for large data transfers.
